'''Colin Ratledge''' {{post-nominals|country=GBR|size=100%|FRSC|FRSB}} (born 9 October 1936) is a British biochemist who was Professor of Microbial Biochemistry at the [[University of Hull]] from 1983 to 2004.<ref name="whoswho">"Ratledge, Prof. Colin, (born 9 Oct. 1936), Professor of Microbial Biochemistry, University of Hull, 1983–2004, now Emeritus." WHO'S WHO & WHO WAS WHO. 1 Dec. 2007</ref>

He was educated at Bury High School,<ref name="whoswho"/> and graduated from [[University of Manchester]] with a BSc in 1957 and a PhD in 1962.<ref name="aocs">{{cite web |title=History of the Stephen Chang Award |url=https://lipidlibrary.aocs.org/resource-material/aocs-awards/history-of-the-stephen-chang-award |website=[[American Oil Chemists' Society|AOCS]] Lipid Library |access-date=17 June 2021}}</ref> He joined the [[University of Hull]] as a lecturer in 1967 and was head of the Department of Biochemistry there from 1986 to 1988.

He was editor of ''[[Biotechnology Letters]]'' from 1996 to 2017.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Ratledge |first1=Colin |title=The time has come; good-bye to all this |journal=Biotechnology Letters |date=January 2018 |volume=40 |issue=1 |pages=1–3 |doi=10.1007/s10529-017-2474-3|pmid=29143166 |s2cid=6008251 |doi-access=free }}</ref> He received the Stephen Chang Award from the [[American Oil Chemists' Society]] in 2011.<ref name="aocs"/> In 2015 the Colin Ratledge Center for Microbial Lipids opened at [[Shandong University of Technology]]. He was awarded an honorary doctorate from [[Ben-Gurion University of the Negev]] in 2018.<ref>{{cite web |title=Two 'pioneering' British scientists honoured by Ben-Gurion University |url=https://jewishnews.timesofisrael.com/two-pioneering-british-scientists-honoured-by-ben-gurion-university/ |website=[[Jewish News]] |date=8 May 2018 |access-date=17 June 2021}}</ref>

He has an [[h-index]] of 58 according to [[Semantic Scholar]].<ref>{{cite web |title=C. Ratledge |url=https://www.semanticscholar.org/author/C.-Ratledge/3662243 |website=[[Semantic Scholar]] |access-date=13 November 2023}}</ref>
